teachingText: When Blue first reaches the radio-sailing zone, Blue is clear ahead and Yellow has not reached the zone. Yellow must give Blue mark-room while rule 18 applies, even after Yellow later establishes a leeward, inside overlap. Yellow becomes the right-of-way boat under Rule 11, but she may not use that right of way in a way that denies Blue the mark-room she still owes.
